entries.title: You can now let a Claude Managed Agents agent use dynamic workflows, in beta with the `managed-agents-2026-04-01` beta header
entries.summary: Managed Agents 智能体可启用动态工作流（beta），后台分阶段运行多智能体并汇总结果。

entries.title: The Compliance API chat endpoints now also return chats from the unified Claude experience
entries.summary: Compliance API 聊天端点现也返回统一 Claude 体验的聊天记录（beta，企业版）。

entries.title: The Compliance API can now download Claude Docs documents as Word files, in beta
entries.summary: Compliance API 现可将 Claude Docs 文档下载为 Word 文件（beta）。

entries.title: We've lowered the price of prompt cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5 from $0.20 USD to $0.10 USD per million tokens
entries.summary: Sonnet 5.5 提示缓存读取价由每百万 token 0.20 美元降至 0.10 美元。

entries.title: We've launched Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`)
entries.summary: 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，1M 上下文、128k 输出、自适应思考，多平台可用。

entries.title: Code written for Claude Haiku 4.5 can break on Claude Haiku 5.5
entries.summary: 为 Haiku 4.5 编写的代码在 Haiku 5.5 上可能报错，需按迁移指南调整。

entries.title: The Python and TypeScript SDKs now include classes, in beta, for the browser use tool and the computer use tool
entries.summary: Python/TypeScript SDK 新增浏览器使用与计算机使用工具的 beta 类。

entries.title: Claude Max and Team plans now include monthly API credits
entries.summary: Claude Max 与 Team 套餐现包含每月 API 额度。

entries.title: In Claude Managed Agents, a cloud environment with `limited` networking now also applies its `allowed_hosts` to the `web_search` and `web_fetch` tools
entries.summary: 受限网络环境的 allowed_hosts 现同样约束 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具。

entries.title: With `limited` networking, creating a session fails with a 400 error when an enabled web tool's `allowed_domains` has an entry not within `allowed_hosts`
entries.summary: 受限网络下 allowed_domains 超出 allowed_hosts 会使创建会话报 400 错误。

entries.title: In Claude Managed Agents, the `web_fetch` tool now fetches only URLs that have already appeared in the session
entries.summary: Managed Agents 的 web_fetch 仅能抓取会话中已出现过的 URL，以防数据外泄。

entries.title: We've added `capabilities.server_tools` to the Models API
entries.summary: Models API 新增 capabilities.server_tools，报告模型是否支持网络搜索与代码执行工具。
